actions.authority: senior administrators (citing the board's June 2026 screen-time vote)
actions.summary: All students blocked from generative AI on district devices for 2026-27 while a new Generative AI Ad Hoc Committee reviews instructional use and safeguards; recommendations due by end of the school year. Teachers may still use AI on district devices.
actions.notes: Confirmed by the district by email 2026-09-02, reported 2026-09-03. Previously students 13+ who completed digital-citizenship training could use approved AI tools. Applies to district-owned devices only; no policy yet on personal devices. Not a board vote - administrators acted 'in the spirit of' the board's unanimous June 2026 screen-time limits, so its durability is weaker than a board-adopted policy. Enrollment figure is approximate.
